scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Still wondering
what to do with
your future, eh?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
From your raiment,
I see that you are
a man of the sword.
Your eyes tell me that
you've seen many a battle.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
From your raiment,
I see that you are
a woman of the sword.
Your eyes tell me that
you've seen many a battle.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Greetings adventurer.
If you happen to know
any new Swordmen,
please direct them to me.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Greetings, my friend.
There is nothing more
that I can teach you...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
This will be my
final lecture to you.
Please listen carefully
as I tell you all about
Magnum Break.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Ah, you've returned. I've just received a communique from
Dequ'ee. It seems you've been working very hard and that you've made the most of this experience.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: You should leave as soon as possible to meet Dequ'ee in Geffen. You do remember where to find him, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
So how has your
training for the Endure
skill coming along?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
So have you
learned how to use
the Endure skill yet?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
The time has come
for me to tell you
all I know about
the Endure skill.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
So have you been
learning more about
the use of the Provoke skill?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Ah, you've returned.
So how has your training
in the use of the Provoke
skill been progressing?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Ah, you've returned. For a new Swordman, you are doing quite
well. So what is the message
from Dequ'ee?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
I wish for you to find a Knight named ^5D478BDequ'ee^000000 in ^5D478BGeffen^000000. Listen carefully, this is the message
I want you to give him.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Ah, you've returned. I know I said that I would teach you what I know about the Provoke skill, but...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Since you've mastered Bash,
I feel that you're ready to learn more about Swordman skills.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
If you want to be
able to use the full
power of the Bash skill,
you better have mastered it
if you want me to acknowledge
you as a fellow Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
I hope you've been
training yourself in using
Bash. If you want to grow as a Swordman, you will have great
need to master this skill.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Have you been learning
the art of using Bash? I fervently believe that the Bash skill is the essense of Swordmanship!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Ah, a comrade in arms.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Shurank Chainlier, a Knight in the service of the Prontera Chivalry.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
If I may be so bold,
I suggest that you follow
the path of strength.
Become... A Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: If you wish to stake your life on the way of the sword, speak to the Swordman Association representative to the left.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Whatever you do,
I hope that you live out your life without any regrets. And if you do happen to become a Swordman,
come back to me...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: There's nothing that I can actually offer to teach you. But if you know any new Swordmen that show potential, please direct them to me.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: My specialty happens to be teaching the fundamentals of the Swordman job to green recruits that have just made the job change.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Although it would be great if everyone can wield a sword,
I'm afraid there's nothing I can effectively teach to you. The methods of your job are...
Foreign to me.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
To improve your skills,
you must explore this vast world and experience all sorts of battle situations. And always commit yourself to your training.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Magnum Break, mastered at Skill Level 10, requires ^5D478BLevel 5 Bash^000000. When used, this skill inflicts splash damage to enemies surrounding the caster.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Enemies struck by Magnum Break
will be pushed back by a Fire property attack. Afterwards, your weapon will temporarily inflict 20% more damage with Fire property attacks.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Magnum Break is ideal for use
when surrounded by foes, but also keep in mind that it also inflicts a little damage on its caster.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: I see that you've been training in the use of Magnum Break. Although it is an awesome skill, it's not for every Swordman. Still, there's no harm in learning it.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Here is a humble reward for
your great efforts. But do not let your talents allow you to grow arrogant!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: That is all I have to teach you about Swordman skills. Hopefully, I've been able to clear up anything you haven't understood about your job and skills.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
As for the matter concerning
that murderer, it's no longer in our hands. At this time, there's nothing that we can effectively
do about it.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
However, I'd like
to ask that you keep the
information you've learned
to yourself. This matter is considered highly classified...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: In any case, there's no need to worry about it anymore. But if we ever need assistance, I'll remember to ask you for your help.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: You've done very well. Continue training and if you reach ^5D478BJob Level 40^000000, you can be promoted to a Knight or a Crusader.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Well...
We Swordmen typically aren't prone to being sentimental, but I'm glad to have met you. Do your best and become a splendid Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: For now, I believe you'll benefit from learning some more about Swordman skills. First, let me tell you more about the Sword Masteries.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
There are two different kinds:
^5D478BOne Handed Sword Mastery^000000 and
^5D478BTwo Handed Sword Mastery^000000. Both
are Passive Skills that increase your Attack Power as these skills are leveled up.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
One Handed Sword Mastery
increases the damage of Daggers and One Handed Swords while Two Handed Sword Mastery increases the damage of Two Handed Swords.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Ah, from the way you handle your Sword, I see that you have mastered a Sword Mastery. I'm thoroughly impressed.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Let me give you
this small reward
in recognition of
your accomplishment.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Next time, I will tell you more about the Magnum Break skill.
I'll be here when you're ready to learn more.

scripts.speaker: Shurank

Next time, I will tell you more about the Magnum Break skill.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: From that gleen of toughness upon your skin, I see now that I was foolish to ask. Well done~

scripts.text:
Ah, once again, I have
another task for you to perform. Please visit Dequ'ee in Geffen since it seems he has something
to ask of you.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Hurry and meet with Dequ'ee and return to me when you complete whatever it is that he wishes for you to do.

Endure skill. Still, it wouldn't hurt if I review the basic details regarding its use...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: As you've noticed, receiving any damage causes you to reel in pain, stunning you for an instant. Thus, rapidly attacking enemies are dangerous since it's difficult to counter or escape them.

scripts.speaker: Shunrank
scripts.text: Activating Endure enables you to shrug off attacks. You'll receive damage, but enemy attacks will not impede you as much. This means you can counter enemy attacks or escape if you need to.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Of course, you can't use Endure forever. However, the more you increase the level of the Endure
skill, the longer Endure's effect will last. Also, remember that Endure also has a skill delay.

scripts.text: Since you've learned the Endure skill already, I don't think I need to explain it any further. You've done well.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:

how it works: Provoke infuriates your opponents, making them
want to attack you.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: When provoked, an enemy will have greater attack strength, making it more dangerous, but will also have reduced defense, making your enemy easier to defeat.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Ideally, you may wish to use Provoke on enemies when they are weakened enough so that you can finish them off more quickly. But that's up to you.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Also, the higher the level of Provoke that is used, the higher the attack increase and defense decrease of your target.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: As an Active Skill, Provoke will consume a small amount of SP, just like Bash. So be careful not to run out of SP when using this skill.

any of your SP.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: It enables you to regenerate your health twice as fast. This might not seem like a big deal, but it will reduce the time you need to rest from battles.

scripts.text:

scripts.text: I believe that every true Swordman should master the Bash skill. If you ever do master the skill as a Swordman, come back to me.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Those calluses...!
Only a master of the Bash skill has those kinds of hands. Great work, Swordman. I'm very impressed.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Here's a small prize in recognition of your efforts thus far. But don't relax yet! You still have a long way to go before grasping
all of the basics.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
You still can't even use Bash...? What's the use of a sword if not to smash things?! Come back to me
once you've learned how to use
that skill!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: It concerns me deeply that the Swordmen of today may not truly understand the way of the sword. And to think that they may become Knights later...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Have you been training
to be an expert Swordman?
If so, you must learn the
fundamentals, the first of
which is the ^5D478BBash^000000 skill.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
^333333*Gasp*^000000
Those soft, delicate hands! You've never learned how to use Bash, haven't you?! How do you expect to lead battles without knowing Bash?

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text: Now, if you wish to become a true Swordman, you must learn the Bash skill. There's no question about it: You've got to know these basics! Take this, and learn to Bash!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
I see that you understand
a little bit about the Bash skill. But still, it's not enough. Let me explain in detail...

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Bash is an active skill, mastered at Level 10, which allows you to smash your target. In essense,
it's a highly damaging attack!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Since it's an active skill, Bash consumes SP each time it is
used. If you're not careful, you'll be out of SP in no time...!

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Well, that's all I can tell you about Bash for now. As for its subtle nuances, you'll have to experience them for yourself
in battle.

scripts.speaker: Shurank
scripts.text:
Still, for your training efforts, let me give you a humble reward. But remember, we still have more
of the fundamentals to cover!

Hey there.

being a Novice?
I know, I know,
we've all been
there once.

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
If you want to become stronger,
why don't you consider becoming a Swordman? It'll require discipline on your part, but that job will shape you into a tough warrior.

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
It's ultimately your decision.
I don't know how you want to live your life, but you should give the Swordman job some serious thought...

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
Ah...
A fellow sword wielder!
How have you been doing?

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
There must be many who must
depend on the strength of your blade. It's an awesome responsibility, but we can never let our allies down in battle...

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
Hello there.
Not a fan of swords, are you?
Well, if you were, we'd have
something to talk about.

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
Yeah.

conversation
happening here.
Pretty boring...

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
I hope you continue
to train yourself in
the ways of the sword.
There's an art to
wielding a blade...

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:

to keep an eye on Bankley?

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
Suicide...?

himself if he suspected that he's been caught. Something shady's going on here!

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:
Well, you've done a good job.
As for the other three suspects, I'll make sure that they're monitored by members of the Swordman Association.

scripts.speaker: Dequ'ee
scripts.text:

It looks like this case is closed for now. Once again, thanks for your help.
